name: mendfix-vscode
description: Automated vulnerability remediation — Mend · Snyk · Dependabot · npm-audit and more

mendfix.outDir.description: Directory for remediation output files (overrides, reports, graph-diff). Maps to CLI --out-dir.

mendfix.verifyVersions.description: Query the npm/Maven registry to confirm recommended versions exist before displaying them. Adds 2–5s per analysis. Maps to CLI --verify-versions.

mendfix.packageJson.description: (npm) Path to the package.json to patch with overrides. When set, the panel pre-fills the Repo target picker. Maps to CLI --package-json.

mendfix.lockFile.description: (npm) Path to package-lock.json. Enables dep-tree features: consumer range validation, dev/runtime chain classification, parent upgrade recommendations. Maps to CLI --lock-file.

mendfix.pomXml.description: (Maven) Path to pom.xml to patch with <dependencyManagement> entries. Maps to CLI --pom-xml.

mendfix.ecosystem.description: Override ecosystem detection. Maps to CLI --ecosystem.

mendfix.applyPhaseB.description: Also apply Phase B overrides (multiple same-major versions or forced overrides). Review the generated phase-b-overrides.json before applying. Maps to CLI --apply-phase-b.

mendfix.autoCommit.description: Auto-commit Phase A fixes after a successful install. The working tree must be clean before apply. Maps to CLI --commit.

mendfix.autoCommitPhaseB.description: Auto-commit Phase B fixes. Requires mendfix.applyPhaseB to also be enabled. Maps to CLI --commit-phase-b.

mendfix.dryRun.description: Print the remediation plan only — write nothing to disk and run no installs. Maps to CLI --dry-run.

mendfix.verbose.description: Print the Safety Gate pre-edit checklist for every item during apply. Maps to CLI --verbose.

mendfix.openPr.description: Open a PR/MR on the CI/CD platform after a successful apply. Requires mendfix.platform and a stored platform token. Maps to CLI --open-pr.

enumDescriptions: GitHub — requires GITHUB_TOKEN stored in SecretStorage
GitLab — requires GITLAB_TOKEN stored in SecretStorage
Azure DevOps — requires AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN stored in SecretStorage
Bitbucket — requires BITBUCKET_TOKEN stored in SecretStorage
mendfix.platform.description: CI/CD platform for --open-pr. Platform tokens are stored securely via VS Code SecretStorage, not in settings. Maps to CLI --platform.

mendfix.prBase.description: Target/base branch for the opened PR. Maps to CLI --pr-base.
